description: NVFP4-CB / FP8-CB codebook container lane: a custom out-of-tree vLLM plugin (vllm_prismaquant_plugin, plugins/vllm_prismaquant/) decodes the codebook schemes into NVFP4/FP8 buffers and delegates plain NVFP4/FP8/BF16 layers to stock compressed-tensors. Deliberately a MIXED container (PLAN.md decision #1, 'FP8 in every recipe'): CB rungs coexist with plain NVFP4, FP8_DYNAMIC and BF16 in one artifact. The scheme vocabulary is prismaquant-custom (NOT stock compressed-tensors, whose schemes cannot express codebooks); ships via prismaquant.export_nvfp4_cb, docs/nvfp4-cb-plan/LAYOUT.md is the byte contract.

format_rules.detail: The nvfp4_cb container carries the two codebook families plus their native carriers. NVFP4_CB_K12..K24 (fp4/E2M1 grid, product VQ, 2.000..3.500 bpw in 0.125 steps) and NVFP4_CB_S13..S16 (fp4 sign-magnitude VQ, 2.125..2.500 bpw) decode to bit-compatible NVFP4 tiles (E2M1 codes + group-16 E4M3 scale) and feed the CUTLASS FP4 path. FP8_CB_K36/40/44/48 (fp8/E4M3 grid, product VQ, 4.5/5.0/5.5/6.0 bpw, per-output-channel fp32 scales) fill the NVFP4->FP8 CT-menu gap and feed the stock W8A8 GEMM. Plain NVFP4 (W4A4 group-16) and FP8_DYNAMIC (W8A8) are delegated to stock compressed-tensors by the plugin; FP8_SOURCE (verbatim native-fp8 weight + 128x128 block weight_scale copy, emitted as the stock float-quantized block-fp8 CT scheme) is likewise plugin-delegated and passthrough-only (never synthesized); BF16 is the unquantized passthrough. Every rung is served only by the out-of-tree vllm_prismaquant_plugin and stays research/candidate until it clears the served gold-metric gate (exact full-vocab vLLM KL-vs-BF16 + WikiText PPL) AND the prefill perf gate (INV-2, no Triton masquerade).

shape_rules.detail: CB rungs pack a 256-weight superblock along the input dim (32 k-bit codewords + the scale plane, type_size = 4k + 16 fp4 / 4k fp8 bytes, integer for every k). The 256-superblock is both the byte-exactness unit and the 8-wide vector-tiling unit; a Linear with in_features % 256 != 0 has no legal CB rung (no block-32 fallback in Phase 0) and is masked back to a coarser legal rung / BF16 by the allocator. This mirrors the FormatSpec group_size=256 divisibility check exactly (double duty), just as gguf.json pins the 256-superblock k-quant/IQ shape rule.
